opportunities.title: Automate WooCommerce EU Dropshipping at Scale
opportunities.description: FINAL PROJECT SPECIFICATIONS & DELIVERABLES (SCOPE OF WORK) Project Title: Enterprise-Level Multi-Channel WooCommerce Automation: Mass Import of 150K+ EU Products (CJ, Syncee, DropXL), Advanced API Sync, Stripe/PayPal Integration, and 100% Hands-Free Ecosystem. Project Description & Objective: To fully connect, technically optimize, and completely automate my WooCommerce store (www.euromalls.eu.com). The ultimate goal is to scale Euromalls into one of the largest online shopping malls in Europe, offering highly competitive pricing and fast shipping across the continent. The entire ecosystem must operate 100% "hands-free" on total autopilot. To build this massive catalog, the freelancer must execute a massive catalog injection from three suppliers (CJ Dropshipping, Syncee, and DropXL). The configuration must be strictly filtered to include 100% of the active product categories and listings distributed from any warehouse located within Europe (Spain, Germany, Poland, and all EU member states) to guarantee fast local delivery times (ranging from 24/72h to a maximum of 3-5 days EU-wide) DETAILED TECHNICAL DELIVERABLES (100% AUTOMATED & HANDS-FREE) 1. Massive 150K+ Reference Catalog Injection & Multi-API Sync • Massive EU Catalog Import: Configure the automated mass-import tools to inject over 150,000+ active references from: • CJ Dropshipping: 100% of active products located in Spain, Germany, Poland, and any other EU-based warehouses. • Syncee: 100% of products filtered for European-based suppliers. • DropXL: 100% of products available for European shipping. • Database & Server Optimization for 150K+ Products: The freelancer must optimize the WordPress database (indexes, transient cleanups) and server PHP settings (e.g., set WP_MEMORY_LIMIT to at least 768MB/1GB and adjust max_execution_time to 300+ seconds) to prevent timeouts, memory crashes, or server crashes during large imports. • Asynchronous "Batching" via Server Cron Jobs: Configure automated server Cron Jobs so that real-time stock and pricing synchronization checks are handled in staggered batches (updating categories at different intervals). This is a strict requirement to keep the front-end loading speeds hyper-fast for customers while managing massive live API traffic. • Automated Bulk Pricing Rules: Set up smart pricing formulas in the supplier backends to auto-calculate competitive retail pricing on WooCommerce while preserving strict profit margins after shipping and payment processing fees. 2. Mandatory "Hands-Free" Logistics & Order Fulfillment Loop The freelancer must ensure that the following three-step fulfillment loop works 100% in the background without any manual data entry or admin management: • Step A (Automatic Order Sync): The exact second a customer makes a successful purchase on WooCommerce, the complete order payload (buyer name, full EU shipping address, specific product SKU/variant) must be pushed via API to the respective supplier dashboard (CJ, Syncee, or DropXL) instantly and automatically. • Step B (Automated Supplier Payment): Set up and verify the Auto-Payment rules in the supplier backends (using digital wallets or linked corporate business cards). opportunities.title: Investigador/a en línea — Búsqueda de personas (Tlo / Idi) — Remoto...
opportunities.description: Buscamos un investigador/a remoto por contrato para localizar y verificar información de contacto actualizada de clientes potenciales. Es un puesto únicamente de investigación: no hay comunicación con clientes ni con clientes potenciales, y no se requiere inglés. El trabajoRealizar búsquedas en TLO (TLOxp) e IDI Data (idiCORE) para localizar números de teléfono, correos electrónicos y direcciones postales actuales Verificar y contrastar los resultados con registros públicos y otras fuentes para garantizar que la información sea actual y precisa Registrar los resultados en nuestra base de datos / software propietario, de forma limpia y organizada, indicando la fuente de cada dato Trabajar con nuestras cuentas acreditadas de las bases de datos, respetando estrictamente las reglas de uso permitido de cada plataforma Horario y pago De 6:00 a. m. A 2:00 p. m., Hora central de EE. UU., De 5 a 6 días por semana, contrato continuo Entre $5 y $7 USD por hora, según la experiencia Requisitos Experiencia práctica con tlo y/o idi data — indique qué plataformas ha utilizado, durante cuánto tiempo y con qué frecuencia experiencia en localización de personas (skip tracing), investigaciones, investigación para cobranzas, apoyo legal o trabajos de investigación similares sólidas habilidades de investigación en registros públicos y excelente atención al detalle computadora propia y conexión a internet estable discreción en el manejo de datos personales para postularse, responda las preguntas de selección a continuación. 1. ¿Qué bases de datos de búsqueda de personas ha utilizado personalmente: TLOxp, IDI Data (idiCORE), LexisNexis Accurint, Thomson Reuters CLEAR u otras? ¿Durante cuánto tiempo y cuántas búsquedas realiza en un día típico? 2. Cuando una búsqueda devuelve varias coincidencias posibles para el mismo nombre, explique paso a paso cómo confirma cuál es la persona correcta. 3. ¿Qué datos adicionales le ayudan más a acotar una búsqueda (fecha de nacimiento, última dirección conocida, nombres de familiares, un número de teléfono parcial)? 4. ¿Cómo verifica que un número de teléfono o correo electrónico encontrado esté vigente y pertenezca a esa persona, y no esté desactualizado o sea de otra persona? 5. Aproximadamente, ¿cuántos registros de contacto completamente verificados puede completar en un turno de 8 horas? 6. ¿Está disponible de 6:00 a. m. A 2:00 p. m., Hora central de EE. UU., De 5 a 6 días por semana, de forma continua? ¿Qué hora es esa en su lugar de residencia? 7. ¿Ha trabajado antes con la cuenta acreditada de bases de datos de un empleador? ¿Conoce las reglas de uso permitido de estas bases de datos? Categoría: Soporte Administrativo Subcategoría: Investigación de mercado ¿Cuál es el alcance del proyecto?: Para un producto, en un país

opportunities.title: Meta Instagram App Review Expert
opportunities.description: We are looking for an experienced freelancer to help prepare and support our Meta App Review submission for a chatbot platform, particularly Instagram messaging. All submissions will be made by us, with your preparation, guidance, and live assistance. We will retain control of our Meta accounts and app. Scope of work * Review our app configuration, chatbot use cases, requested permissions, and any previous rejection feedback. * Confirm the exact permissions and access levels required for our integration. * Identify missing prerequisites, including any applicable business or Tech Provider access verification requirements. * Prepare submission answers, permission justifications, screencast, reviewer instructions, and testing steps. * Help prepare and validate screencasts, test accounts, and demonstrations. * Guide us through the submission during a screen-sharing session. * Analyze Meta’s feedback and prepare corrections for resubmission. * Provide a final handover documenting the approved permissions and any ongoing requirements. If technical changes are needed, provide clear instructions for our development team. Significant development work must be quoted separately before work begins. Required experience and evidence You must have personally supported successful Instagram messaging App Review approvals. Please provide at least two examples, including: * Approval date and approved permissions. * Your specific role in preparing and securing the approval. * Any rejection reasons you resolved. General Meta advertising, Business Manager, or WhatsApp setup experience alone is insufficient for this project. Deadlines cover your work. Time awaiting Meta’s review, our documents, or development fixes is excluded. Any blocker must be reported promptly with the required next action. Resubmissions included Your fixed fee must include: * One initial submission. * Three resubmission rounds, including revised answers, reviewer instructions, screencasts where needed, and guided submission assistance. * Clarification responses related to those submissions. If an included submission is still awaiting Meta’s decision at that point, support for that round must continue through the response and its analysis. Additional rounds require a separately agreed price. Payment structure Please quote these separately: 1. Fixed fee: Paid against accepted deliverables—25% for the audit and the complete initial submission package and guided submission, and 75% after approval or completion of the included support scope. 2. Success fee: Paid only after Meta approves all permissions and access levels agreed in the initial audit, confirmed in our own App Dashboard. Partial approval does not trigger the success fee. Accepted fixed-fee deliverables remain payable regardless of Meta’s decision. Please include in your proposal * Your relevant approval evidence. * Your proposed fixed fee and separate success fee. * Confirmation that three resubmissions and the stated deadlines are included. * Your availability and what you need from us to begin. * Any exclusions or additional charges. We understand that Meta makes the final decision. We are looking for proven experience, accurate preparation, and responsive support throughout the review process.

opportunities.title: Urban Infrastructure Development Plan
opportunities.description: I need a full-scale roadmap that addresses our city’s infrastructure development needs. The work revolves around assessing current assets, spotting short-, mid-, and long-term gaps, then outlining practical, data-driven projects that will bring the network up to modern standards while accommodating future growth. Scope of work • Conduct a baseline study of existing roads, utilities, and public facilities, drawing on traffic counts, utility capacity data, and demographic projections. • Prioritise interventions using objective criteria: urgency, cost-benefit, environmental impact, and alignment with local policy. • Produce concept designs and high-level cost estimates for each proposed project, supported by GIS maps and phasing schedules. • Include risk analysis, funding strategy options, and measurable performance indicators so decision-makers can track progress post-implementation. Deliverables 1. Comprehensive written report (PDF & editable Word) summarising research, analysis, and recommendations. 2. GIS shapefiles and layered maps marking proposed upgrades and new assets. 3. Five-year and ten-year implementation plans with clear milestones. 4. Presentation deck (PowerPoint) distilling key findings for stakeholders. Acceptance criteria • Recommendations must be evidence-based and reference all data sources. • Cost estimates broken down by labour, materials, contingencies, and permitting. • Maps must be georeferenced and compatible with QGIS and ArcGIS. • All content delivered in English and formatted for A4 printing. Preferred tools include AutoCAD, Civil 3D, QGIS/ArcGIS, and Microsoft Project, but I’m open to equivalent industry-standard software if you justify the choice. Once the final package meets these criteria, I’ll sign off immediately so you can receive prompt payment and testimonials. I’m ready to move quickly and will be available for clarifications throughout the engagement.

opportunities.title: Stake Game Analytics Dashboard -- 3
opportunities.description: Stake Casino Prediction Bot I play Crash and Dice on Stake every day and I want a bot that pulls the live game feed, analyses the full history in real time, and tells me one thing—what will come next—so I can place my wager with total confidence. The bot must: • Work only with Stake’s Crash and Dice games and most importantly the mines • Continuously scrape or call the game feed, store past results, and refresh its model on the fly. • Use any statistical, pattern-recognition, or machine-learning technique you trust to display a single, crystal-clear prediction before each round starts. • Present the prediction in a small GUI or console window; no auto-betting is required right now. • Run fast enough that I still have time to act on the information in the same round. Deliverables 1. A fully functional, self-contained script with well-commented source code. 2. Setup instructions that let me reproduce identical results on my Windows 10 machine. 3. A short read-me explaining the logic, data points, and libraries you used (Python + Selenium, Node.js + Puppeteer, or similar are all fine). Acceptance Criteria – The bot connects to Stake in real time and logs every new round without manual input. – Before each Crash or Dice round begins, it outputs its prediction (next multiplier or roll). – I can install and run it locally and see the same predictions you demonstrate. If you have a working prototype or past work predicting casino outcomes, show me what you’ve got and let’s make this tool a reality. Web Scraping Statistical Analysis Data Analysis Data Science Python PHP C++ Programming Software Architecture Predictive Analytics

opportunities.title: Modelos 3D y Animaciones Armadas
opportunities.description: Necesito crear un paquete básico de personajes humanos listos para integrarse en Godot Engine. Los modelos deben tener una calidad media con un máximo de 10 000 polígonos y un rig bien organizado que permita equipar distintas armas sin problemas de deformación. Busco: • Modelo(s) humano(s) con esqueleto compatible con Godot, pesos correctamente pintados y materiales PBR simples. • Puntos de anclaje en las manos para que las armas se puedan acoplar o intercambiar fácilmente. • Conjunto de armas modeladas que incluya: – Pistola – Rifle – Escopeta – Arma cuerpo a cuerpo • Animaciones clave: idle con arma, caminar con arma en mano y disparo/ataque correspondiente para cada tipo de arma. Entrego el proyecto en Godot, por lo que agradeceré que los recursos vengan exportados en formatos compatibles (GLB/GLTF o DAE) y, si es posible, una pequeña escena de prueba que muestre el personaje cambiando de arma y ejecutando las animaciones. Quedo atento a tu propuesta, tiempos estimados y ejemplos de trabajos similares.

opportunities.title: Recover Permanently Banned WhatsApp
opportunities.description: My primary WhatsApp number now shows the dreaded banner “This account can no longer use WhatsApp.” I triggered the in-app “Request a review,” but Meta’s team rejected it, leaving me completely locked out. The ban happened while I was on the official WhatsApp from the App Store—no third-party mods, no Business version—yet the account is still mission-critical for my personal and professional communications. I need a specialist who has successfully overturned permanent bans before and understands Meta’s internal escalation paths, policy language, and evidence requirements. Your role is to guide or directly handle every step of the appeal process until the number is reactivated and can send and receive messages again. Deliverables • A clear action plan outlining the escalation route and any supporting documentation I must provide • Drafted appeal emails or forms in Meta-compliant language, ready for me to submit (or submitted on my behalf if you have that access) • Ongoing updates on each appeal stage and any additional evidence needed • Confirmation of full account restoration (code arrives, number verifies, chats functional) Success is measured solely by my number being live on WhatsApp again. If you have verifiable experience reversing permanent bans, I’m ready to start immediately.

opportunities.title: Aplicación Web Consumo API
opportunities.description: Quiero una aplicación web que consuma mi servicio REST a través de varios endpoints protegidos con autenticación Bearer Token. El token ya estará embebido en la app, por lo que no habrá pantalla de inicio de sesión: solo necesito que cada petición incluya automáticamente el encabezado Authorization correspondiente. Alcance • Conectar a los endpoints que te proporcionaré e inyectar el Bearer Token en todas las llamadas. • Mostrar los datos en una interfaz limpia y responsive que funcione en cualquier navegador moderno. • Permitir al usuario ver la información y buscarla mediante filtros o cuadro de búsqueda. Requisitos técnicos • Puedes trabajar con React, Vue, Angular o vanilla JavaScript; elige la opción que mejor domines. • Manejo de estados y peticiones asíncronas con fetch, Axios o equivalente. • Estructura de archivos clara y comentada para que pueda mantenerla después. Entregables 1. Código fuente completo. 2. Breve guía de instalación/ejecución (README). 3. Demostración funcional alojada en un entorno temporal (por ejemplo Netlify, Vercel o similar) para revisión inicial. Valoraré un diseño simple pero pulido, uso correcto de promesas/async-await y buenas prácticas de seguridad al almacenar el token en memoria.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40807718, publicado hace 8 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 250 - 750.

opportunities.title: Dubai and UAE Corporate AI Training Sales Associate
opportunities.description: B2B Sales Associate – Dubai & UAE Corporate AI Training Engagements (Commission-Based) About MedOS AI Tech University Website: www.medosaitech.com MedOS AI Tech University is an AI-focused professional training and technology education organization offering specialized enterprise training programs in: Generative AI Agentic AI Enterprise AI Architecture AI Engineering AI Agents and Multi-Agent Systems Enterprise AI Transformation AI Strategy and Governance We are expanding our international corporate training business and looking for a proactive, results-driven B2B Sales Associate to acquire corporate training clients across Dubai and the United Arab Emirates. This is a remote, commission-based opportunity with attractive earning potential. 1. Project Objective Your primary responsibility is to identify UAE organizations interested in AI workforce upskilling, approach corporate decision-makers, introduce our enterprise AI training programs, and secure paid online corporate training engagements. Our objective is to establish long-term corporate training partnerships with UAE enterprises, government-related organizations, universities and professional education providers. 2. Target Geography – Dubai & UAE We are looking for corporate training opportunities across: Dubai Abu Dhabi Sharjah Ajman Ras Al Khaimah Fujairah Other major UAE business hubs. Priority will be given to candidates with strong corporate networks in Dubai and Abu Dhabi. 3. Key Responsibilities Identify UAE companies interested in Generative AI and Agentic AI workforce training. Build a database of corporate prospects and decision-makers. Identify and approach: Chief Technology Officers (CTOs) Chief Information Officers (CIOs) Chief Human Resources Officers (CHROs) Learning & Development Directors HR Directors Digital Transformation Leaders AI Strategy and Innovation Heads Enterprise Architects Corporate Training Managers Conduct B2B cold emailing campaigns. Conduct business development calls to UAE companies. Execute LinkedIn outreach and relationship building. Introduce MedOS AI Tech University's corporate AI training solutions. Identify workforce training requirements, participant numbers and budgets. Schedule discovery meetings with corporate decision-makers. Coordinate proposals, commercial discussions and follow-ups. Convert qualified prospects into paid corporate training engagements. Maintain prospect information and sales activities in our CRM. 4. Training Programs to Sell Primary Offering: Enterprise Agentic AI Training Our corporate training programs cover: Generative AI Fundamentals Large Language Models (LLMs) Advanced Prompt Engineering Agentic AI Architecture AI Agents and Multi-Agent Systems LangChain and LangGraph Model Context Protocol (MCP) Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Enterprise AI Architecture AI Automation and Business Workflows Enterprise AI Security and Governance AI Application Development and Deployment AI Strategy and Enterprise Transformation Training programs can be customized according to the client's industry, technical requirements and employee skill levels. 5. Target Customers We are interested in engaging with: Large enterprises and multinational corporations Banking and financial services Real estate and construction companies Healthcare and hospital groups IT and telecommunications companies Government and semi-government organizations Aviation and logistics companies Energy and industrial organizations Consulting and professional services firms Universities and educational institutions Technology startups Corporate learning and development providers 6. Candidate Requirements Proven experience in B2B sales or corporate business development. Experience selling corporate training, IT services, SaaS or technology consulting. Excellent English communication and presentation skills. Arabic communication skills are an advantage. Experience selling to UAE enterprises is strongly preferred. Comfortable with cold calling, cold emailing and LinkedIn prospecting. Ability to communicate with senior corporate decision-makers. Familiarity with Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, HubSpot or similar CRM tools. Ability to independently generate qualified business opportunities. Candidates based in Dubai, Abu Dhabi or elsewhere in the UAE with established corporate networks will be preferred. 7. Compensation Structure Engagement Type: Freelance / Independent Sales Associate Monthly Fixed Salary: No fixed salary. Compensation: Performance-based commission on successfully closed and collected corporate training revenue. Commission percentages and payment terms will be mutually agreed upon before onboarding. High-performing sales associates may be offered a long-term international business development partnership. 8. Monthly Performance Expectations Activity Monthly Target Corporate prospects identified 150 Decision-makers identified 100 Personalized cold emails 200 LinkedIn outreach 150 Follow-up calls 50 Qualified corporate meetings 8–10 Corporate proposals submitted 4–5 Paid training engagements 1–2 These are indicative targets and will be reviewed based on campaign performance. 9. What MedOS Provides Corporate AI training curriculum. Experienced AI trainers and technical subject matter experts. Trainer profiles and professional credentials. Corporate AI training brochures and presentations. Customized corporate training proposals. Pricing and commercial support. Technical support during client meetings. Online training delivery. Support throughout client onboarding. 10. Expected Deliverables The selected sales associate will be responsible for: Building a qualified UAE corporate prospect database. Identifying relevant decision-makers. Conducting email, LinkedIn and telephone outreach. Generating qualified corporate training leads. Scheduling meetings with interested organizations. Coordinating proposal submissions. Following up on commercial discussions. Securing paid corporate AI training engagements. 11. Important Conditions This is a business development and revenue-generation assignment, not merely a data-entry project. We are looking for candidates capable of converting prospects into paying corporate clients. All leads and sales activities must be recorded in the designated CRM. All prospects generated must remain within the MedOS sales pipeline. No unauthorized commitments or misleading representations about MedOS or its training programs. Commission is payable on eligible client payments actually received by MedOS. Sales associates must comply with applicable UAE marketing, privacy and telecommunications regulations. 12. How to Apply Please answer the following questions in your Freelancer proposal: Are you currently based in Dubai or elsewhere in the UAE? Which UAE cities do you have corporate contacts in? How many years of B2B corporate sales experience do you have? Have you previously sold corporate training or IT services in the UAE? Do you have experience approaching HR, L&D, CTO or CIO decision-makers? Are you fluent in English and Arabic? Can you independently conduct cold calling, email and LinkedIn campaigns? Which lead-generation and CRM tools do you use? How many qualified corporate meetings can you generate monthly? Are you comfortable working on a commission-only basis? Can you share examples of previous corporate sales achievements? opportunities.title: Build AWS AI Demo Agent
opportunities.description: AI Demo Agent: Project Brief 7 Nov 2026 · @Devon Goal and scope A "Get demo" button starts a live video call where an AI agent runs a tailored demo by voice, answers questions from your FAQ, and passes qualified leads to your team. • Built from your 30+ recorded demos (30-40 min each) and your FAQ • Runs on AWS, built with Claude Code, embedded in your software • Available 24/7; similar in idea to Hyper AI (gethyper.ai) • Not in version 1: agent operating a live copy of your software, phone calls, talking avatar Customer journey 1. Customer clicks "Get demo" and the call connects in seconds. 2. Agent asks role, organization and the problem to solve. 3. Agent picks 3-5 chapters from your 30+ demos, turning 30-40 minutes into a tailored 10-15 minute demo. 4. Agent plays each chapter and narrates; the customer can interrupt ("go back", "how does billing work?"). 5. Agent answers from your FAQ and demo transcripts; if the answer isn't there, it flags a person. 6. Agent books a sales call, sends a recap email, and logs the summary to your CRM. Who does what Claude writes the code, a developer deploys it on your AWS account, and your team supplies content and decisions. Claude (in Claude Code) • Project scaffold, voice agent and agent tools (pick chapters, play, pause, search FAQ, book meeting, hand off) • Pipeline that transcribes the demos, splits them into 2-4 minute chapters and tags them • FAQ retrieval, "Get demo" widget and call screen • CRM, calendar and email integration code • AWS infrastructure as code (AWS CDK), tests and documentation Developer • Prepare the AWS account and environments; request Claude model access on Amazon Bedrock • Deploy, and review Claude's code before it goes live • Store credentials in AWS Secrets Manager; embed the widget in your software • Monitoring, cost limits, backups and security review • Privacy and healthcare compliance setup (AWS BAA, encryption, access logs) if patient data is involved Your team • Provide the 30+ demo recordings and the FAQ • Review chapter tags; decide the agent's name, voice, tone and what it must never say • Choose the CRM and calendar and give access • Run test calls and report what feels wrong • Approve legal text (recording consent, privacy notice) and set handoff rules AWS services for the live video call Amazon Chime SDK is the core; speech, Claude, video delivery and call servers surround it. Service Role in the call Amazon Chime SDK (Meetings) Live audio and video room for customer and agent (web, iOS, Android); data messages tell the browser "play chapter 3" Chime SDK Media Pipelines (or Kinesis Video Streams) Sends the customer's audio to the agent; records calls Amazon Transcribe (streaming) Speech to text Amazon Bedrock (Claude) The agent's brain: chooses chapters, calls tools, answers Amazon Polly Text to speech, streamed into the call Amazon S3 + CloudFront Store and deliver demo videos; the browser plays chapters locally, in sync with the agent AWS Elemental MediaConvert Converts recordings to streaming formats Amazon ECS on AWS Fargate One agent worker per live call (too long-running for Lambda) Amazon API Gateway + AWS Lambda Starts the call, issues join tokens, receives webhooks Amazon DynamoDB Live session state and call logs Amazon Route 53 + Certificate Manager Domain and HTTPS Optional: Cognito, Nova Sonic, avatar Cognito for customer sign-in; Nova Sonic (speech-to-speech, lower delay) to test later; a talking avatar is third-party, not AWS AWS services for knowledge, integration and security Area Services FAQ and answers Bedrock Knowledge Bases + OpenSearch Serverless (retrieve from your FAQ and transcripts); Bedrock Guardrails (blocks unsupported or off-topic replies) Demo library pipeline S3 upload, EventBridge + SQS, then Step Functions + Lambda: Transcribe (batch), chapter, tag with Claude, store Follow-up and CRM Amazon SES (recap email); API Gateway + Lambda (CRM and calendar); Secrets Manager (credentials) Security KMS (encryption), IAM (least access), WAF (bot protection), CloudTrail (audit log) Operations CloudWatch + X-Ray (delay, errors, cost per call); AWS CDK + CodePipeline or GitHub Actions (deployment) Compliance: AWS lists most of these as HIPAA eligible, but the developer must confirm the current list and sign the AWS Business Associate Addendum if patient data is involved. Phases Five phases reach a live pilot in roughly 10-14 weeks (estimates to confirm with your developer). 1. Setup (1 week). Your team sends demos, FAQ and CRM choice; developer prepares AWS and Bedrock access. 2. Prototype (2-3 weeks). One demo, 10 FAQs, voice call in a browser. Gate: your test call approves voice and flow. 3. Demo library (2-3 weeks). All 30+ demos chaptered and tagged, full FAQ loaded. Gate: your team reviews tags and sample paths. 4. Integration (2-3 weeks). Widget in your software, CRM, calendar, recap email, handoff. Gate: end-to-end test. 5. Pilot (2-4 weeks). Real customers, limited volume, human review of every call. Gate: go or no-go. Later, optional: agent operating a live copy of your software, phone calls, avatar, more languages. Risks and open decisions Six decisions from your team unlock the build. [ ] Viewer: a buyer watching a demo, or a patient being guided through the software? [ ] Which CRM and calendar? [ ] Which languages at launch? [ ] Does any demo show real patient data? [ ] Avatar, or voice plus shared demo screen only? [ ] Who receives handoffs, and how fast must they respond? Risks • Voice delay: replies slower than about one second feel unnatural; stream speech and test in the prototype. • Wrong answers: the agent answers only from the FAQ and transcripts, uses Guardrails, and flags a person when unsure. • Patient data: needs AWS BAA, encryption, access logs and review by a qualified person; Claude can build to the requirements but cannot certify them. • Recording consent: your legal team approves the notice wording. • Cost per call: video, speech and Claude bill per use; measure in the prototype.

opportunities.title: Enhance Mitutoyo MCOSMOS Program - 07/11/2026 10:35 EST
opportunities.description: I have an existing MCOSMOS routine on a Mitutoyo CMM that needs expert attention. The part we measure is fairly intricate, full of true-position, profile, and orientation call-outs, and the current program is either missing features or flagging false deviations. My goal is to walk away with a clean, reliable routine that hits every GD&T requirement and runs without operator intervention. What I can supply: the native 3D CAD model with its drawing as well as the current MCOSMOS program and a sample part for correlation. You will be free to probe the model, compare code, and verify touch points directly on the machine (Geopak/PartManager environment). Your task is to review the existing program, correct any probing paths or alignment logic, add any missing datum checks, and validate that the results match the drawing. Once finished, I’d like the updated .prt file, any custom alignment schemes, and a short summary of changes so future edits are easy to follow. Deliverables • Revised MCOSMOS program ready to load and run • Updated alignments and probe paths for all GD&T features • Change log or brief write-up outlining what was fixed or added • Confirmation run on my sample part showing all features within tolerance If you work daily with Mitutoyo machines, MCOSMOS, Geopak, or CAT1000P and are comfortable troubleshooting complex GD&T routines, I’m ready to get started.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40807540, publicado hace 11 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: INR 750 - 1,250.

opportunities.title: WhatsApp API Business Verification
opportunities.description: I need to move our existing Meta Business account all the way to “Verified” so we can finally open the WhatsApp Business API. We are a small team of freelancers in Erbil, Iraq working under one member’s legal name and, at the moment, we have no company registration, tax licence, utility bill, or bank statement in a business name. Because of that, the usual documentation path does not apply to us and the account is still sitting in an unverified state. Your job is to use your first-hand experience with Meta Business Manager, Facebook Developer Console and the WhatsApp Business Platform to: • map out exactly which sole-proprietor or personal documents Meta currently accepts in this region, • prepare and submit those files inside Business Manager, configuring every required field so the details on the documents match the profile, • handle any follow-up questions from Meta, including a possible appeal, until the green “Verified” badge appears. The work is finished when the account shows “Business verified” and the WhatsApp API phone number can be requested without additional compliance warnings.

opportunities.title: Modern Pub 3D Renderings
opportunities.description: I need photorealistic still images that capture a modern, upscale pub with an integrated dining area. The space is already designed; what’s missing are high-quality visuals that will convey the concept to investors and help finalize finish selections. I will provide floor plans, reference photos, exact furniture specifications, and a materials palette. Using that information, I expect fully lit, textured, and post-processed renders that look true to life and highlight the premium feel of the design—think sleek surfaces, sophisticated lighting, and a warm yet contemporary atmosphere. Deliverables • 4–6 high-resolution (4K) JPEG or PNG images showing key viewpoints: main bar, dining zone, entrance perspective, and one hero shot capturing the full ambience. • One round of minor revisions to tweak materials, colors, or camera angles. All work should be done in a professional 3D package (3ds Max, Blender, or similar) with V-Ray/Cycles/Corona-quality output. I’ll need both the final images and the original scene file so my team can archive the project. When sending your proposal, let me know your preferred software, estimated turnaround, and a link to at least one comparable interior render you’ve produced.

opportunities.title: Edición Limpia de Reels
opportunities.description: Estoy preparando una serie de contenidos cortos para Instagram, TikTok y YouTube Shorts. Dispongo del metraje bruto en formato vertical (1080 × 1920) y un breve outline por pieza. Quiero transformar cada clip en un video limpio y profesional, con edición sencilla: cortes precisos, ritmo fluido y sin efectos agresivos. Elementos imprescindibles • Música de fondo suave, libre de derechos, perfectamente sincronizada. • Exportación final en .mp4 H.264 1080 × 1920. • Archivo editable de CapCut (o equivalente) para ajustes posteriores. Opcional, pero bienvenido • Subtítulos cuando el audio no sea claro. • Miniatura estática con texto destacado siguiendo la estética del video. Alcance inicial: 10 videos de 30-60 s. Si el resultado encaja, el flujo será recurrente. Para coherencia visual facilitaré paleta, tipografía y logotipo. También escucho sugerencias sobre hooks, duración ideal y buenas prácticas de retención. Entregables por video 1. Video final listo para publicar. 2. Proyecto editable. 3. Assets utilizados (fuentes, música, etc.) con referencia de licencias. Indica tu tiempo estimado para el lote y ejemplos de trabajos similares.

opportunities.title: Realistic 3D Product Modeling
opportunities.description: I need a photorealistic 3D model of a single fashion, cosmetic, or accessory item that will be featured in my online store and promotional materials. The model must capture the exact look and feel of the real product—including full texture, accurate materials, and true-to-life proportions—so that it can stand alone as imagery on product pages and ads. Scope of work • Build one high-fidelity model optimized for web and marketing use (glTF/GLB, FBX, or OBJ—whichever you prefer). • Provide clean UVs, PBR textures, and a minimum of four high-resolution still renders showing the product from different angles (front, back, side, and a dynamic close-up). • Lighting should be neutral studio style to keep color reproduction consistent. Acceptance criteria 1. Geometry, scale, and details match reference photos I will supply. 2. Textures remain crisp at 4K; no visible seams or stretching. 3. Final renders delivered as transparent-background PNGs plus layered source files so I can change backgrounds later. 4. Model must load smoothly in typical WebGL viewers without exceeding reasonable poly counts. Please let me know your preferred file format, any past examples of fashion or cosmetic items you have modeled, and the approximate turnaround time you can commit to once you receive my references.

The model must capture the exact look and feel of the real product—including full texture, accurate materials, and true-to-life proportions—so that it can stand alone as imagery on product pages and ads. Scope of work • Build one high-fidelity model optimized for web and marketing use (glTF/GLB, FBX, or OBJ—whichever you prefer). • Provide clean UVs, PBR textures, and a minimum of four high-resolution still renders showing the product from different angles (front, back, side, and a dynamic close-up). • Lighting should be neutral studio style to keep color reproduction consistent. Acceptance criteria 1. Geometry, scale, and details match reference photos I will supply. 2. Textures remain crisp at 4K; no visible seams or stretching. 3. Final renders delivered as transparent-background PNGs plus layered source files so I can change backgrounds later. 4. Model must load smoothly in typical WebGL viewers without exceeding reasonable poly counts. Please let me know your preferred file format, any past examples of fashion or cosmetic items you have modeled, and the approximate turnaround time you can commit to once you receive my references."

opportunities.title: Accurate Blender Robot Modeling Required
opportunities.description: # Hiring: Expert Blender 3D Artist – Accurate Hard-Surface Robot Modeling **Project Type:** Fixed-price 3D modeling **Software:** Blender **Budget:** Negotiable ### Project Description I am looking for an experienced 3D artist to recreate a futuristic spherical robot from a supplied reference image with the highest possible accuracy. The model must closely match the reference in terms of proportions, shape, mechanical construction, armor panels, colors, materials, and fine details. I am not looking for a redesign or creative interpretation. ### 3D Modeling Requirements - Highly accurate recreation of the supplied reference. - Clean, professional hard-surface geometry. - Detailed spherical body with segmented armor. - Individually modeled armor panels. - Separate mechanical thruster components. - Separate face screen, eyes, and mouth. - Accurate mechanical connections and surface detailing. - High-quality materials and textures. ### Important: Editable Component Structure The entire model must be fully editable and organized into clearly named Blender Collections and separate objects. I must be able to independently: - Change individual armor panels. - Modify armor colors and materials. - Replace or modify the eyes and facial expressions. - Change thruster components. - Modify mechanical details. - Add or remove accessories. - Hide, replace, or customize components without affecting the rest of the model. Please avoid permanently joining independent components into a single mesh. ### Required Deliverables 1. Complete editable Blender `.blend` source project. 2. Individual mesh components organized into Collections. 3. FBX export with separate mesh components. 4. UV mapping and editable PBR materials. 5. All associated texture files. 6. Front, rear, left, right, top, and bottom orthographic renders. 7. Three-quarter perspective render matching the supplied reference. 8. Wireframe screenshots showing mesh construction. ### Additional Requirements - The model must use consistent dimensions, origins, and alignment. - Components must remain independently editable. - All source files must be included. - Full commercial usage rights and assignment of the agreed intellectual property rights are required. - The work and supplied reference must remain confidential and cannot be published or shared without written permission. **No animation or rigging required.** ### When Applying Please share examples of your previous hard-surface 3D modeling work, especially mechanical robots or sci-fi designs. I will prioritize accuracy, clean geometry, and proper Blender project organization over rendering effects.

opportunities.title: Travel with ismail
opportunities.description: I run a Moroccan tourism agency that specialises in desert and adventure tours, and I need a clean, engaging website that lets visitors explore our itineraries and reach me easily. The site’s core job is simple: present each tour with photos, highlights, pricing, and a clear “Contact Us” or WhatsApp call-to-action so potential guests can ask questions or request a quote. A fast, mobile-first build is essential because many of our travellers research on their phones while already on the road. I’d like a straightforward CMS—WordPress, Webflow or another user-friendly platform—so I can add new trips or update dates without coding. Multilingual support (English first, with room to add French or Spanish later) will be a bonus, as will basic on-page SEO for “Morocco desert tour,” “Merzouga camel trek,” and similar phrases. Deliverables • Responsive website (home, tours listing, single-tour page, about, contact) • Contact form plus clickable phone/WhatsApp links • Easy-to-update CMS backend with clear instructions • Photo gallery integration and location map for each tour • Light branding to match our colours and desert imagery Once the site is live, I may explore adding online booking and payment, but for now viewing tours and contacting me is enough. If this sounds like a build you can turn around quickly and elegantly, let’s talk.

opportunities.title: Solución Mensajes WhatsApp Cloud API
opportunities.description: Estoy atascado con la Meta WhatsApp Cloud API: mis mensajes no salen ni entran. El número está verificado, dispongo del token de acceso y del phone_number_id, pero algo en la configuración —webhook, permisos o llamadas al endpoint— impide el flujo completo. Busco a alguien con experiencia comprobable depurando la Cloud API, que pueda: Envié documentos de verificación de negocio y lleva varias semana en estado EN REVISION Trabajo en tiempo real (Zoom/Meet + Postman o similar) hasta ver al menos un mensaje saliente y uno entrante funcionando. Así confirmamos juntos que el problema queda resuelto y cierro el proyecto.

opportunities.title: BetBurger Automated Betting Integration
opportunities.description: # Automated Sports Betting Bot – BetBurger Integration Hi! I'm looking for an experienced developer specializing in browser automation and bot development to **build an automated sports betting bot from scratch, using selections from BetBurger**. I'd like to explain how the system should work and the main requirements of the project. ### 1. Project Objective My goal is to develop a system that **automatically reads the betting selections displayed on BetBurger and places the corresponding bets at the relevant bookmakers**, without requiring manual intervention. I use approximately **10–15 different bookmakers**, including LeoVegas, Paf, SpeedyBet, GoldenBull, Winamax, 888, Betway, and others. **I will personally configure BetBurger**, including all the filters, criteria, and betting opportunities I want to see. The bot doesn't need to find betting opportunities on its own or decide which bets are worth placing. Its only job is to detect the selections displayed on BetBurger and execute those bets automatically, quickly, and reliably. ### 2. Bot Functionality The system should be able to: - Automatically read the betting selections displayed on BetBurger. - Identify the bookmaker, sporting event, betting market, selection, and odds. - Access the corresponding bookmaker's website. - Automatically search for and locate the correct match or sporting event. - Find the specified betting market and selection. - Verify that the available odds are still acceptable. - Add the selection to the betslip. - Enter the corresponding stake. - Automatically confirm the bet when all the required conditions are met. - Detect errors, odds changes, suspended markets, or rejected bets. - Record the outcome of each operation. ### 3. BetBurger Integration A fundamental part of the project is ensuring that the bot can automatically and reliably read the selections displayed on BetBurger. The ideal workflow would be: 1. BetBurger displays a betting selection based on the filters I've already configured. 2. The bot detects the selection and extracts the necessary information. 3. It identifies the corresponding bookmaker. 4. It searches for the event and betting market. 5. It verifies that the bet is still available under the required conditions. 6. It automatically places the bet. 7. It records the result and moves on to the next selection. If multiple selections appear, **the bot does not need to place bets simultaneously**. It can process them **one at a time**, completing each operation before moving on to the next. The important thing is that the process is sufficiently fast and reliable. ### 4. Technical Approach and Environment I don't have any strict preferences regarding the technologies or tools used. I'm open to whichever technical solution you consider most appropriate, as long as the system works reliably. I also don't mind if the bot switches between browser tabs, uses automated mouse and keyboard interactions, or processes bets sequentially. You would have the freedom to choose the architecture and technologies you believe are best suited to the project. ### 5. Anti-Bot Detection and Human-Like Behavior **This is one of the most important requirements of the project.** Bookmakers use different systems to detect automated activity, so I'm looking for someone with experience working with websites that have anti-bot protection. I would like the system to: - Behave as similarly as possible to a real human user when navigating websites. - Interact with pages naturally, avoiding excessively mechanical or repetitive patterns. - Operate reliably on websites with anti-bot protection systems. - Minimize the risk of detection, account restrictions, or interruptions caused by automation. - Properly handle errors and security verification challenges. - Maintain consistent performance over extended periods. I'm particularly interested in a developer who has previously worked on automation projects involving websites with advanced bot detection systems. I'd also appreciate an explanation of any potential limitations and the technical solutions you would recommend. ### 6. Speed, Stability, and Reliability Speed is important because many BetBurger selections involve live sports betting, where odds can change very quickly. The bot should: - Detect selections with minimal delay. - Quickly locate the corresponding events and betting markets. - Verify the available odds before confirming a bet. - Skip selections when the odds no longer meet the requirements. - Prevent duplicate bets on the same selection. - Detect errors and recover from them whenever possible. - Maintain a log of successfully placed bets and failed attempts. - Operate autonomously for extended periods. The bot doesn't necessarily need to handle multiple bets at the same time. I'd prefer a system that reliably processes one bet after another rather than a more complex system that is less stable. ### 7. Questions Before Getting Started I'd like to know: 1. Have you worked on similar projects before, particularly sports betting bots or browser automation systems? 2. How would you approach this project from a technical perspective, and which technologies would you use? 3. Do you have experience working with anti-bot protection systems and automation designed to mimic human behavior? 4. What would your approximate development cost be? Would it be possible to divide the project into two stages? **My idea is to divide the development into two stages:** - **Stage 1:** Build a fully functional version that reads selections from BetBurger and automatically places bets at a single bookmaker. I'd like to verify that the system works properly, with good speed, stability, and reliability, before moving forward. - **Stage 2:** If the first version works well and meets all the requirements, we would gradually expand the system to support the remaining 10–15 bookmakers. I'd appreciate a separate quote for the first stage and a rough cost estimate for the second stage. **The budget is flexible, and I'm open to negotiating the price depending on your experience, proposed technical approach, and the scope of the work.** I'm looking for a skilled and reliable developer with whom I could potentially build a long-term working relationship, while keeping development and maintenance costs reasonable. Thank you!

opportunities.title: USA/UK B2B Tech Sales Partners
opportunities.description: # International Client Acquisition Partner (USA & UK) ### Commission-Only | B2B Technology | Long-Term Partnership Briquicks Technologies is an India-based technology company looking to expand its presence in the United States and United Kingdom. We are seeking experienced, self-employed business development professionals based in the USA or UK who can help us acquire international clients and establish long-term business relationships. ## About Briquicks Technologies We specialise in delivering technology solutions to businesses, including: - Artificial Intelligence (AI) Automation - AI Agents, Voice Agents and Chatbots - Custom Software Development - SaaS Application Development - Web and Mobile Application Development - Shopify and E-commerce Solutions - Business Process Automation - Digital Transformation and Technology Consulting Website: https://www.briquicks.com/ ## Responsibilities - Identify and acquire potential business clients in the USA and UK. - Generate and qualify B2B leads, particularly among SMEs and startups. - Conduct outreach through LinkedIn, email and professional networks. - Connect with business owners, founders and decision-makers. - Identify business requirements and present relevant technology solutions. - Manage sales opportunities and convert prospects into paying clients. - Build and maintain long-term client relationships. ## Compensation and Collaboration Model This is an independent business partnership, not a salaried employment position. - Commission: 10%–30% per successfully closed deal. - Uncapped earning potential. - No fixed salary or monthly retainer. - No upfront marketing or operational fees. - Commission calculated on actual revenue collected from clients introduced and acquired by the partner. - Opportunity for long-term collaboration and revenue-sharing arrangements. Commission percentages will be mutually agreed upon based on deal size, contribution and responsibilities. ## Ideal Candidate - Currently based in the United States or United Kingdom. - Self-employed business development professional, independent sales consultant or entrepreneur. - Proven experience in B2B sales and client acquisition. - Experience selling IT services, AI solutions, software development or digital transformation services is preferred. - Strong communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills. - Ability to independently identify opportunities and engage decision-makers. - Commercially driven and interested in long-term business partnerships. ## How the Partnership Works The Client Acquisition Partner will focus on identifying opportunities, generating leads, managing initial client engagement and driving sales conversions. Briquicks Technologies will provide technical consultation, solution design, software development, project execution, technical resources and delivery management. Both parties will work together to establish profitable and sustainable client relationships. ## How to Apply Interested professionals are requested to share: 1. Full name and current location. 2. LinkedIn profile. 3. Previous B2B sales and business development experience. 4. Industries and services previously sold. 5. Examples of successful client acquisitions, where available. 6. Preferred commission and collaboration structure. We are interested in building a long-term partnership with the right people. Website: https://www.briquicks.com/

opportunities.title: Revit Residence Model & Views
opportunities.description: My submission deadline is racing toward me, and I have only the ground- and first-floor layouts of a small residence sketched by hand. The drawings show room sizes, dimensions, and every door and window, but I still need the full digital package: a complete Autodesk Revit model that automatically spits out clean sections, elevations, and presentation-ready 3D views. You will receive high-resolution scans of the two floor plans the moment we start. From those images, I need you to rebuild the house faithfully in Revit, assign correct levels, walls, doors, windows, floors, and a simple roof, then let the software generate the orthographic sheets. Keep the detailing basic—structure and openings are enough—as the main goal is to demonstrate technical comprehension, not interior styling. Deliverables (all required for submission) • Native .rvt file with the fully modelled residence • Two longitudinal and two cross sections placed on sheets • All principal elevations on sheets • At least three high-resolution 3D views (axonometric or perspective) exported as JPEG/PNG • PDFs of every sheet for quick printing Accuracy to the given dimensions is critical; everything must line up with the sketches. A short walkthrough video or screen-record showing the model is a plus but not mandatory. I’m happy to answer questions quickly because time is short. Let me know your turnaround and any clarifications you need, and we can get started right away.

opportunities.title: High-Impact Social Promo Video Edits
opportunities.description: I’m producing a series of short promotional clips that will live on Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube Shorts, and I need them to look and feel premium. Each video must instantly sell the product while keeping viewers engaged to the final frame. Here’s what I’m after: clean cuts, smooth yet energetic transitions, eye-catching motion graphics, on-brand typography, and a balanced sound mix. I’ll supply raw footage, brand guidelines, product images, and any copy needed; you transform that material into scroll-stopping content that feels native to each platform’s style limits and aspect ratios. Deliverables • Final videos in vertical format (1080 × 1920), ready for direct upload to Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, and YouTube Shorts • An exported teaser thumbnail for each clip • Project files (Premiere Pro / After Effects or equivalent) neatly organised so my in-house team can make minor tweaks later Acceptance Criteria 1. Visual flow matches the reference pace I’ll share (≈15–30 seconds per clip). 2. Brand colours and fonts are applied consistently. 3. Motion graphics highlight key product benefits within the first 5 seconds. 4. No artefacts, abrupt cuts, or audio pops in the final render. 5. All files delivered by the agreed deadline. If you thrive on impactful social storytelling and can keep a tight turnaround, let’s talk and lock in the first batch.

opportunities.title: 2D Human Sprite Walk & Crawl
opportunities.description: I already have a rough concept for a human-style 2D character and now I need all of the movement animations brought to life directly inside Blender. The focus is simple: a complete set of walk cycles in every cardinal and diagonal direction, plus matching crawl cycles in those same directions. No extra attacks or idles—just fluid, game-ready locomotion. What I expect from you • A clean Blender file containing the rig and finished animations. • Exported PNG sprite sheets (or individual frames, if you prefer) for each direction of both the walk and crawl cycles, ready to drop into my engine. • Consistent frame counts and timing across every direction so I can swap animations without hiccups. I’ll supply the character reference, palette, and exact frame size once we start. If you’ve handled multi-direction 2D rigs in Blender before, this should be a straightforward assignment. Looking forward to seeing the character finally move!

opportunities.description: Necesito un diseñador que cree un folleto para promocionar un negocio o servicio. Solo requiero una pieza: incluirá nuestro logo, los datos de contacto y las redes sociales, presentados de forma clara y atractiva. Entrego el contenido textual y el archivo del logo; tú te encargas de la diagramación, la elección de tipografías y la propuesta de colores que mejor refuercen la imagen de marca. Entregables: • Folleto listo para imprimir en PDF alta resolución (tamaño A4 o carta, a una o dos caras según convenga). • Versión optimizada para redes sociales en formato JPG/PNG. • Archivo editable (AI, PSD o InDesign) para futuras actualizaciones. Busco un resultado limpio, profesional y fácil de leer. Si tienes ejemplos de trabajos similares, adjúntalos para evaluar tu estilo.

opportunities.title: Especialista en Ethical hacking y Blindaje de VPS
opportunities.description: Estamos buscando un ingeniero senior en ciberseguridad y hacking ético de habla hispana (preferiblemente ubicado en España o franja horaria compatible) con un fuerte perfil de ingeniería de sistemas y mentalidad de agencia. Actualmente gestionamos una infraestructura crítica en un servidor VPS que aloja 17 aplicaciones dockerizadas, páginas web con wordpress, html y Astro, además de flujos de automatización en n8n. Requerimos un profesional con experiencia real y contrastada para auditar, blindar y establecer un sistema de monitorización y recuperación ante desastres continuo. Aviso importante: No leemos propuestas automáticas ni generadas por IA. opportunities.title: Edición Video Vertical Creativo
opportunities.description: Tengo varias grabaciones de videos hablando a cámara que necesito convertir en un contenido vertical pulido y listo para publicar en Instagram y TikTok. Te enviaré el material en bruto y espero que, con criterio editorial, construyas un video fluido: corta repeticiones y silencios, reorganiza las ideas para que mantengan coherencia y ajusta el ritmo para que el mensaje se entienda sin esfuerzo. El archivo final deberá incluir subtítulos incrustados con palabras clave grandes y animadas que resalten los conceptos centrales. También confío en ti para limpiar el audio, corregir color cuando sea necesario y dejar la pieza lista para usarse tal cual, en 1080 × 1920 px, preferiblemente en .mp4. Si tienes experiencia editando verticales para redes y dominas herramientas como Premiere Pro, Final Cut o DaVinci Resolve, envíame enlaces a trabajos similares, dime cuánta disponibilidad tienes y tu tarifa por este tipo de proyecto. Espero tu propuesta para empezar cuanto antes.

opportunities.title: Querétaro - Evaluar atención y servicio de manera presencial -- 7
opportunities.description: La actividad consiste en pedir información y solicitar una cotización de manera presencial en una empresa asignada por nosotros. Para realizar satisfactoriamente la actividad se requiere de lo siguiente: 1. Estudiar guía proporcionada por nosotros, comprender lo que se requiere mencionar y lo que se requiere cotizar, tener comunicación con nosotros por este medio antes de iniciar la actividad para aclarar el objetivo y resolver cualquier duda. (Tiempo aproximado 1 hora, de la cual son 30 minutos de estudio de guía y 30 minutos para resolver dudas). 2. Presentarse en la empresa y sucursal asignada para recibir explicación personal del servicio y confirmación de cotización. (Tiempo aproximado 30 minutos + el traslado) 5. Enviarnos la cotización recibida por correo electrónico y un formulario de evaluación (Tiempo aproximado 30-60 minutos). En total se requieren de 3 a 4 horas para completar la actividad, el pago es fijo y es de $50 USD una vez que la actividad fue completada satisfactoriamente. Requerimientos del Freelancer: A. Vivir en la ciudad de Querétaro. B. Contar con medio de transporte (auto o motocicleta). C. Edad mínima 25 años. D. Contar con un smartphone con Android y/o iOS y tener la app de Freelancer instalada en su teléfono móvil con las notificaciones activadas. (Una de las principales causas de que los proyectos no se logren satisfactoriamente es debido a que los Freelancers no están al pendiente de sus mensajes o no reciben las notificaciones causando una comunicación tardía, por este motivo te pedimos instalar la app y estar al tanto de la misma para beneficio de todos). Si te interesa participar en esta actividad y no has hecho la misma anteriormente realiza tu bid por la cantidad fija $50 USD y escribiendo en el mensaje el municipio en el que vives para confirmar que no eres un bot. Bids por cantidades mayores a $50 USD no serán considerados. Se contratarán varios shoppers para esta actividad. Gracias.

Para realizar satisfactoriamente la actividad se requiere de lo siguiente: 1. Estudiar guía proporcionada por nosotros, comprender lo que se requiere mencionar y lo que se requiere cotizar, tener comunicación con nosotros por este medio antes de iniciar la actividad para aclarar el objetivo y resolver cualquier duda. (Tiempo aproximado 1 hora, de la cual son 30 minutos de estudio de guía y 30 minutos para resolver dudas). 2. Presentarse en la empresa y sucursal asignada para recibir explicación personal del servicio y confirmación de cotización. (Tiempo aproximado 30 minutos + el traslado) 5. Enviarnos la cotización recibida por correo electrónico y un formulario de evaluación (Tiempo aproximado 30-60 minutos). En total se requieren de 3 a 4 horas para completar la actividad, el pago es fijo y es de $50 USD una vez que la actividad fue completada satisfactoriamente. Requerimientos del Freelancer: A. Vivir en la ciudad de Querétaro. B. Contar con medio de transporte (auto o motocicleta). C. Edad mínima 25 años. D. Contar con un smartphone con Android y/o iOS y tener la app de Freelancer instalada en su teléfono móvil con las notificaciones activadas. (Una de las principales causas de que los proyectos no se logren satisfactoriamente es debido a que los Freelancers no están al pendiente de sus mensajes o no reciben las notificaciones causando una comunicación tardía, por este motivo te pedimos instalar la app y estar al tanto de la misma para beneficio de todos). Si te interesa participar en esta actividad y no has hecho la misma anteriormente realiza tu bid por la cantidad fija $50 USD y escribiendo en el mensaje el municipio en el que vives para confirmar que no eres un bot. Bids por cantidades mayores a $50 USD no serán considerados. Se contratarán varios shoppers para esta actividad. Gracias."

proposal.body:
¡Hola Solicitante Anuncio #40805199 (Tareas en Español)! 👋 Revisé la solicitud exacta de **"Querétaro - Evaluar atención y servicio de manera presencial -- 7"** y cumplo con los requisitos para iniciar de inmediato.

Realizo **bioconstrucción en guadua, muro tendinoso con botellas y vidrio, todo tipo de cubiertas y estructuras en metal/soldadura, café especial borbón rosado, murales artísticos, modelado 3D en Blender y planos**.

📲 Contacto directo en San Agustín, Huila (Colombia): **+57 322 273 9034**.
